name: Elune's Grace
summary: From Dolanaar, night elf priests return to Darnassus for Elune's Grace. The rite marks their readiness to wield divine talents unique to their people.

sections.title: A Sacred Milestone
sections.body: A priest's path in the Sisterhood of Elune calls for more than skill in prayers of mending and smiting. As acolytes gain experience, they reach a threshold where they may receive blessings granted only to the kaldorei. Local mentors such as Laurna Morninglight in Dolanaar cannot bestow these deeper arts, so they send promising disciples to the spiritual heart of their order.

sections.title: Audience at the Temple
sections.body: Initiates cross Teldrassil to the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus. Beneath the gaze of the high priesthood, Priestess Alathea judges whether each petitioner is ready to bear the goddess's defensive mantle. Elune's Grace is taught there as a divine talent reserved for the kaldorei.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
faq.answer: After gaining enough practical experience, night elf priests return to Darnassus for a rite of passage. At the Temple of the Moon, Priestess Alathea tests them and teaches the defensive art of Elune's Grace.

Priestess Alathea is a high-ranking priest trainer at the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus. She oversees the formal training and advancement of night elf acolytes, judging whether they have the spiritual focus for advanced racial prayers.

faq.q: Why can't local mentors teach this ability?
faq.answer: Outpost mentors such as Laurna Morninglight guide novices through foundational teachings, but the Sisterhood reserves sacred blessings unique to the kaldorei for formal conferral. Acolytes travel to the order's central seat of devotion in Darnassus for evaluation before learning these deeper gifts.

faq.q: What does Elune's Grace actually represent in kaldorei faith?
faq.answer: Elune's Grace represents the Moon Goddess's direct protection. Woven through prayer, it diminishes the force of incoming attacks and reflects Elune's sheltering presence over her faithful when danger draws close.

faq.q: Can priests of other races receive this blessing?
aliases: is elunes grace night elf only
faq.answer: No. Elune's Grace belongs to the ancestral faith and worship of the kaldorei. Only night elf priests who commune directly with the Moon Goddess are taught its invocation.

faq.q: Where does this journey begin and end?
faq.answer: Laurna Morninglight summons the acolyte from Dolanaar on Teldrassil to the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.

angles.text: As a night elf priest, this rite grounds you in the Sisterhood of Elune's celestial magic rather than universal holy practices.
As a night elf, the pilgrimage to the Temple of the Moon reflects Elune's central place in kaldorei society, bringing distant acolytes to the heart of Darnassus.
